title: Rounded rectangular rod
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to negative ninety degrees around the X-axis, zero degrees around the Y-axis, and negative ninety degrees around the Z-axis. Set the translation vector to zero for all axes. Begin by creating a new face and draw a two-dimensional sketch. Start the first line from the origin at zero, zero to zero point zero two eight eight, zero. Draw the second line from zero point zero two eight eight, zero to zero point zero two eight eight, zero point seven five. Continue with the third line from zero point zero two eight eight, zero point seven five to zero, zero point six eight two seven. Finish the loop by drawing the fourth line from zero, zero point six eight two seven back to the origin. Ensure the loop is closed to form a quadrilateral. Apply a scaling factor of zero point seven five to the two-dimensional sketch. Rotate and translate the scaled two-dimensional sketch using the previously defined coordinate system. Extrude the two-dimensional sketch zero point zero two eight eight units in the direction of the normal to create a new solid body. The final dimensions of the rounded rectangular rod are length zero point zero two eight eight four six one five three eight four six one five three eight zero six units, width zero point seven four nine nine nine nine nine nine nine nine nine nine nine eight nine units, and height zero point zero two eight eight four six one five three eight four six one five three eight zero six units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0288, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0288, 0.75) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.6827) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.0288)

# Apply the coordinate system transformation
# The Euler angles are (-90.0, 0.0, -90.0) and the translation vector is (0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
# This transformation is equivalent to rotating the object 90 degrees around the X-axis and then 90 degrees around the Z-axis
r = r.rotate((0, 0, 0), (1, 0, 0), 90) \
     .rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 1), 90)

# The final model is represented as 'r'

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Square column with a beveled (chisel) top
# Profile drawn in the YZ plane, extruded along X

a = 0.0288      # square cross-section side
h = 0.7500      # total height
bevel_top = 0.7230  # height of the low side of the bevel

r = (
    cq.Workplane("YZ")
    .moveTo(0.0, 0.0)
    .lineTo(a, 0.0)
    .lineTo(a, h)          # full-height side
    .lineTo(0.0, bevel_top)  # slanted bevel face
    .close()
    .extrude(a)
)

lanes.label: Kimi K3 (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

a = 0.0288
h = 0.7500
bevel_rise = 0.0700

r = (
    cq.Workplane("YZ")
    .polyline([(0, 0), (a, 0), (a, h), (0, h - bevel_rise)])
    .close()
    .extrude(a)
)
